buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF6B5E] to-[#8B5CF6] text-white rounded-full font-bold shadow-[0_4px_14px_rgba(255,107,94,0.39)] hover:shadow-[0_6px_20px_rgba(255,107,94,0.23)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1A1C22] text-white border border-white/10 rounded-full hover:bg-[#252830] transition-all
buttons.me_tinca: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF6B5E] to-[#8B5CF6] text-white rounded-full font-bold text-lg py-4 px-8 shadow-lg shadow-[#8B5CF6]/30 hover:scale-105 transition-transform

cards.discover_profile: relative h-[70vh] max-h-[700px] w-full rounded-[32px] overflow-hidden bg-black shadow-2xl
cards.group_card: bg-[#1A1C22] p-5 rounded-[24px] border border-white/5 flex flex-col gap-3 transition-colors hover:bg-[#252830]

inputs.base: w-full bg-[#0E0F13] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl px-5 py-4 text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8B5CF6]/50 focus:border-[#8B5CF6] transition-all placeholder-white/30

motion.page_transition: framer-motion fade and slight slide up
motion.breathing_animation: framer-motion pulsing concentric circles, scaling from 1 to 1.5 with opacity fading, 4-second cycle. Colors soft #38BDF8 and #8B5CF6 gradients.
motion.card_swipe: framer-motion drag='x' with rotation based on drag offset
motion.match_modal_reveal: framer-motion scale-up with glowing backdrop blur

onboarding_bg.description: Friends hanging out, representing connection and safe spaces

icons.usage: Heart, Users, Shield, MessageCircle, MapPin, Search, Calendar, User, Sparkles (for 'Me tinca ✨')

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application as a mobile-first responsive web app (if on desktop, contain within max-w-md mx-auto like a mobile frame, or provide a clean grid extension).
Apply dark theme strictly: background #0E0F13, cards #1A1C22.
Implement the 'Match por plan' modal: when a user clicks 'Me tinca ✨', trigger a modal '¿Qué plan harías con [Nombre]?' before sending.
Ensure 'Necesito apoyo' page features an interactive/animated breathing circle (use framer-motion scaling + opacity).
NEVER use the words 'adicto' or 'rehabilitación' in UI text. Keep copy warm and Chilean (e.g., 'me tinca', 'panorama', 'junta').
Use color categorization across UI: Amor (Coral), Amistad (Yellow), Apoyo (Blue), Grupos (Violet).
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='me-tinca-button').
